product_overview: K2 Support Agent is an AI-powered customer support application that provides an on-site Copilot chat popup for end users and a protected admin panel for conversation, document, and audit log management. It integrates CopilotKit and Strands-based chat backends with RAG, tool calling, and observability.
core_goals: Provide an easy-to-use AI support chat (CopilotKit primary, Strands alternate) on the public home page to deliver instant answers, tool-driven actions, and human handoff.
Offer a secure admin panel for authenticated staff to review conversations, manage uploaded documents, and inspect audit logs.
Support tool integrations (create_ticket, request_refund, schedule_call, handoff_to_human) from the agent runtime and surface tool results in the UI.
Ensure observability, rate limiting, and guardrails for safe, auditable LLM interactions.
Enable straightforward developer onboarding and deployment via Next.js, AWS Bedrock, DynamoDB, S3, and CDK.

features.name: User Login
features.description: Authenticate admin users with email and password (NextAuth credentials provider) to access the protected admin panel.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Click Sign In button to submit -> Redirect to /admin -> See admin dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Click Sign In button to submit -> See error message 'Invalid email or password' -> Remain on /login
Navigate to /login -> Leave email field empty -> Fill password input field -> Click Sign In button to submit -> See validation error for email field -> Remain on /login
Navigate to /login?callbackUrl=/admin -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Click Sign In button to submit -> Redirect to callbackUrl (/admin) -> See admin dashboard

features.name: Home and Support Chat
features.description: Public landing page with feature cards and a CopilotKit chat popup that sends messages to the Copilot runtime and can perform tool actions and human handoffs.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View feature cards (Instant Answers, Smart Actions, Human Handoff) -> Open chat popup -> Type message into chat input -> Click Send in chat popup -> POST /api/copilotkit is made -> See agent response message in chat

Navigate to / -> Open chat popup -> Type a request that triggers a tool (e.g., refund) -> Click Send in chat popup -> POST /api/copilotkit is made -> See tool action card or confirmation message in chat
Navigate to / -> Click Admin Panel link -> Redirect to /admin (if authenticated) -> See admin dashboard
Navigate to / -> Click Admin Panel link -> Redirect to /login (if not authenticated) -> See login page

Navigate to / -> Open chat popup -> Type message -> Click Send in chat popup -> POST /api/copilotkit is made -> Receive rate limit or server error response -> See error message banner in chat 'Request failed or rate limit exceeded' -> Chat remains open

features.name: Admin Panel
features.description: Authenticated dashboard at /admin for viewing conversations, managing documents in S3, and inspecting per-conversation audit logs.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> If session exists, see admin dashboard with Conversations, Documents, Audit Log tabs -> Click Conversations tab -> View conversation list -> Select a conversation from the list -> See message history and conversation details
Navigate to /admin -> Click Documents tab -> Click Upload or drag-and-drop a file into upload area -> POST /api/documents is made -> See uploaded document listed in Documents tab
Navigate to /admin -> Click Documents tab -> Select a listed document -> Click Delete document control -> DELETE /api/documents is made -> See document removed from Documents list
Navigate to /admin -> Click Audit Log tab -> Select a conversation -> GET /api/conversations (audit) is made -> See audit log entries for the selected conversation
Navigate to /admin -> Click Chat link -> Redirect to / -> See home page
Navigate to /admin -> Click Sign Out -> Session ends -> Redirect to /login -> See login page
Navigate to /admin -> If not authenticated, middleware redirects to /login -> See login page
Navigate to /admin -> Click Documents tab -> Attempt to upload unsupported or oversized file -> POST /api/documents returns error -> See upload error message 'Upload failed' -> Document not listed
